verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents all three mechanisms in the story: background sub-agents spawned from a run to parallelize research and slow tool work, a Swarm feature that orchestrates many concurrent sub-agents from Code Mode scripts with bounded fan-out, structured results and live progress, and an A2A 1.0 JSON-RPC channel that lets external agents discover the gateway and submit tasks. Release notes also mention teams of specialist agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that sub-agent or swarm parallelism splits real work as described, and clear documentation of OpenClaw initiating outbound A2A delegation rather than only receiving tasks.
